notes: Consents are now documents. Settings → Patient forms → Forms has a Policies group: the privacy notice, the consent for exam and X-rays and the office policy, each its own document, read and signed one after the other. Edit opens a simple text editor: paste your text from Word or Google Docs (fonts, colours, tables and pictures are left out), format it with headings, bold, italic, underline, lists, sizes and links, and use Insert for a checkbox, an initials box, or your practice's name, address, phone or email. English and Spanish are side by side, with a phone preview. New policy adds one; drag to change the order. Patients read each policy as one page (a short summary first when you set one), and after the first signature each next policy signs with one tap. Each signed policy is its own PDF in Open Dental with its whole text. Who we may discuss care with and detailed voicemails are now on the New patient form. Your current consents are converted on update, word for word.
